name: Speak with Bink
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
adventurer!  Bink, my gnome colleague in Ironforge, sends word.  She has a task that needs doing and won't rely on anyone but a mage to do it!  Are you that mage, adventurer?

If so, then speak with Bink.  She spends her time in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh, I can see you have promise, yes you do! But it takes more than promise to be a good mage.  And if you're not a good mage, then you're a bad mage.  And bad mages are part of the problem, yes they are!

Oops, I'm getting ahead of things.  Let's begin at the start!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 10, 935 XP in all.
